policy.admission: reuse canonical heavy-only source layout/global CA/global THR-beta checks and declared-link endpoint validation; retain every refusal, no stripping H/altloc/occupancy or crop/replacement to gain entry
policy.angular: canonical tetrahedral H angles, each original C-H radius; all nonmethyl initial coordinates and existing heavy atoms exact
policy.audit: all admissions, groups, initial energy grids, callback paths, original endpoint equality and adverse geometry; broader whole-System continuation requires its own declared transport/control plan
policy.groups: all graph methyls: existing carbon with exactly three newly mobile H and one heavy bonded neighbor, canonical protein context; second-shell heavy frame chosen within residue first then full atom identity; no guessed frame
policy.limits: research-only new protein contexts, not original OpenCL THR2 replay, production default/repair, full-complex or broad chemistry qualification; 1UBQ remains an explicit known occupancy-scope control
policy.ownership: all three touched H must be absent from pre-H observations and mobile in original H System; no measured/kept H rewrite
policy.physics: original Reference H-only tolerance1.0/max50; no force/exclusion/mass changes, H regeneration during arms, additional seed/profile/iteration search or integration
policy.preparation: one legacy prepare per admitted projection, standard naming, unchanged PROPKA/Reduce/pH; PDBFixer and H placement explicitly Reference, H seed1; require resource readiness first
policy.projection: unchanged project_first: first coordinate model and first ATOM chain, retain exact ATOM H/altloc/occupancy/numbering and all touching LINK/SSBOND/CONECT; original bytes retained separately
policy.selection: all methyls phase0 first; energy-selected arm makes exactly one pass over parent identities in lexicographic case-sensitive order; each group evaluates 0..345 by15 degrees in original System energy, retains best, no revisit or final/native scoring
policy.source_capture: two predeclared H seeds1,2, forced protein-H rebuild and Reference on prepared/dat; observe native H Context and first whole-System start without performing full native refinement
policy.ties: 1e-8 kJ/mol, shortest signed canonical phase then signed angle
policy.timing: convenience input set fixed before graph-initializer implementation/source admission/H-control outcomes; sources previously used in other research, not blinded or temporal holdout
